rules.title: Airline-Caused Cancellation Entitlement
rules.source_text: If a flight is cancelled by the airline: Customer may choose free rebooking on the next available flight within 24 hours OR customer may choose a full refund. This is the customer's choice.
restrictions: Customer must choose one option (mutually exclusive)
Rebooking must be on next available flight within 24 hours
Rebooking must be at no charge

rules.title: Refund Processing Constraints
rules.source_text: Refund is processed in full within 7 business days. Refund must be issued to the original payment method. The agent must not process a refund to a different payment method.
restrictions: Must be to original payment method ONLY
Cannot refund to different payment method

rules.title: Delay More Than 3 Hours Compensation
rules.source_text: Delay more than 3 hours → meal voucher + lounge access
rules.notes: Source explicitly states 'meal voucher + lounge access'. Meal voucher appears to be the ₹500 voucher from Tier 1.

rules.title: Delay More Than 5 Hours Compensation
rules.source_text: Delay more than 5 hours → meal voucher + hotel accommodation covering only the delayed hours, not a full night's stay
restrictions: Hotel accommodation covers delayed hours ONLY
rules.notes: Source does NOT mention lounge access in Tier 3. Whether Tier 3 includes lounge access is POLICY_UNSPECIFIED (see AMBIGUITY-02).

rules.title: Fare Difference Waiver Authority Limit
rules.source_text: If a customer voluntarily chooses to rebook onto a higher-fare flight: Customer must pay the fare difference. Agent cannot waive a fare difference above ₹1,500 without supervisor approval.
restrictions: Agent cannot waive amounts above ₹1,500 without supervisor approval
rules.notes: Source states agent CANNOT waive above ₹1,500. It does NOT explicitly state agent CAN or MUST waive amounts ≤₹1,500. This is an inference, not explicit source statement.

rules.title: Loyalty Tier Priority Rebooking
rules.source_text: Gold customers receive priority rebooking. Platinum customers receive priority rebooking. Gold and Platinum do not receive additional compensation beyond the standard policy.
restrictions: NO additional compensation beyond standard policy
rules.notes: Silver tier is not mentioned. 'Priority rebooking' operational definition is POLICY_UNSPECIFIED.

rules.title: Agent Rebooking Authority
rules.source_text: Rebook an airline-caused cancelled flight on the next available flight within 24 hours at no charge.
rules.notes: Source explicitly limits this to CANCELLED flights. Delayed flight rebooking is NOT explicitly authorized.

rules.title: Agent Refund Initiation Authority
rules.source_text: Initiate a refund for an airline-caused cancellation.
restrictions: Must be to original payment method

rules.title: Mandatory Escalation - Compensation Beyond Policy
rules.notes: Any compensation not explicitly in Assignment 3 Data Pack requires escalation.

rules.title: Mandatory Escalation - Fare Difference Waiver Above ₹1,500
Mandatory Escalation - Refund to Different Payment Method
rules.source_text: Any request to refund to a payment method other than the original payment method.

ambiguities.title: Delay Threshold Boundaries
ambiguities.description: Natural language 'under 3 hours', 'more than 3 hours', 'more than 5 hours' creates mathematical ambiguity at exact boundary values (3.0h, 5.0h).
ambiguities.source_gap: Source does not explicitly define behavior at exact boundaries.

ambiguities.title: Delay Tier 3 Lounge Access
ambiguities.description: Source states Tier 3 (>5h) provides 'meal voucher + hotel accommodation' but does NOT mention lounge access. Whether Tier 3 also includes lounge access from Tier 2 is unspecified.
ambiguities.source_gap: Source does not explicitly state whether benefits accumulate across tiers.

ambiguities.title: Agent Authority for Delayed Flight Rebooking
ambiguities.description: Source explicitly authorizes agent rebooking for 'airline-caused cancelled flight' but does NOT explicitly authorize rebooking for delayed flights.
unspecified_cases: Can agent rebook customers on delayed flights to alternate flights?
ambiguities.source_gap: Rebooking authority scope limited to cancelled flights in source.

ambiguities.title: Fare Difference Waiver Applicability Context
ambiguities.description: Source mentions 'voluntarily chooses to rebook' but does not specify whether this applies only to customer-initiated upgrades or also to airline-initiated rebookings that result in higher fares.
unspecified_cases: When does fare difference waiver authority apply?

ambiguities.title: Next Available Flight Definition
ambiguities.description: Source uses phrase 'next available flight within 24 hours' without operational definition.

ambiguities.title: Full Refund Scope
ambiguities.description: Source states 'full refund' but does not define scope (base fare? taxes? fees? baggage?).

ambiguities.title: Business Days Definition
ambiguities.description: Source states refund processed 'within 7 business days' but does not define business days (jurisdiction, holidays).

ambiguities.title: Original Payment Method Definition
ambiguities.description: Source requires refund to 'original payment method' but does not define this technically.

ambiguities.title: Delayed Hours Hotel Accommodation Duration
ambiguities.description: Source states hotel 'covering only the delayed hours' but does not provide operational definition.

ambiguities.title: Priority Rebooking Operational Definition
ambiguities.description: Source states Gold/Platinum receive 'priority rebooking' but does not define this operationally.
unspecified_cases: What does priority mean in practice?
